title: Fix UTF-8 BOM fatal parse error in API GrievanceController
summary: Removed a UTF-8 BOM from the start of `App/Controllers/Api/GrievanceController.php` that caused a fatal PHP namespace parse error when loading `/grievance`.

items: Stripped leading UTF-8 BOM bytes so `namespace` is the first real statement.
docs/CHANGES.md: added note for the parse-error fix
